title: Consolidate three drifted-style copies of unit pricing into shop.pricing and add clearance markdowns

hidden_checks.spec: A: VOLUME_TIERS, MEMBER_DISCOUNTS, MARGIN_FLOOR = Decimal('1.10'), CLEARANCE_MARKDOWN = Decimal('0.30') with the stated current values.
Current behavior 1 / A: volume fraction of the tier with the largest min_qty <= qty.
Current behavior 2-3 / A: member discount after volume, unknown tiers and customer=None get 0, round half up.
Current behavior 4 / A step 3: floor cost * MARGIN_FLOOR rounded up to the cent.
A step 1: override replaces discounts; still rounded half up and floored.
A step 1: if clearance, v = max(v, CLEARANCE_MARKDOWN) (never stack); member fraction still applies.
A step 3: unless clearance, raise to the floor; clearance items may sell below the floor (also with override).
A steps 1-3 for all combinations; with clearance=False exactly today's calculation.
B: tables are read at call time and patched with mock.patch.object; A: list order must not matter.
B: Cart, Quote and Receipt obtain every unit price from shop.pricing.unit_price with clearance=inventory.is_clearance(sku).
B: carts evaluate clearance when lines()/total() runs.
Current behavior: a quote locks its unit price at add() time and add() returns it; B: quotes evaluate clearance in add(); override on clearance items not floored.
Current behavior: till merges scans and prices at lines() time; B: clearance in the till; checkout takes stock.
B: patched VOLUME_TIERS must be followed by all three channels.
B: patched MEMBER_DISCOUNTS must be followed by all three channels.
B: patched MARGIN_FLOOR must be followed by all three channels.
B: patched CLEARANCE_MARKDOWN must be followed by all three channels.
Current behavior preserved: cart merges repeated adds, Cart.add stock check, qty validation, unknown sku (existing code).
Current behavior preserved: Quote.accept all-or-nothing reservation; accepting twice raises (existing code).
Current behavior preserved: Receipt.checkout all-or-nothing; unknown sku (existing code).
